info.title: PitSeeder
info.description: Command-line tool for seeding, exporting, and querying JsonPit data stores. Supports WWWA foreign key resolution, JSON export to file or stdout, and piping to jq.

options.name: --debug
options.description:
	enable debug output
-r, --pitroot		root directory containing pits

options.name: --cloud
options.description:
	cloud provider name (looks up root in Os.Config)
-s, --source		source file for import (JSON or JSON5)
-e, --export		export directory for JSON output

options.name: --help
options.description:
	print out all options
-v, --version		print version info
-n, --nologo		do not display the banner
